Longeron (upper starboard)
parts.prov: CLAUDE_DESIGN v0.5.7 (structure/longeron_study.py, kT 2026-10-25 'consolidate'): four CFRP tubes in an X, matching canon's 4 axial longerons. The upper pair stay where the v0.5.6 slot sills were (edging the bay slot); the lower pair mirror them in the tank's lower cells. Sized at 5 g x 1.5 to a 250 MPa design stress (400 MPa floor x 0.62 for impact, joints, environment). v0.5.6 had 3 planks + 2 sills (36.9 t) running at 65 MPa. NON-GOVERNING; SOL TO REVIEW REV 5 (structure review 2026-10-26): wall 72 -> 84 mm (area 0.0830 m2, 1% margin) so axial + bending (thrust-line offset 13.5 MN m + 0.5 deg thrust error 9.1 MN m) stays within the 250 MPa design stress
